title: evidence
description: Output of 02_EXTRACT: one statement of the paper with the excerpt that supports it. Contract proposal: docs/evidence-contract-proposal.md (decisions of Fonseca, 2026-11-07). There is no status field: VERIFIED lives in verification.status (CLAUDE.md section 4).

job_id.description: editorial.jobs.id; existence is checked by code

model.description: model name, or not_reported when the stage used no LLM

created_at.description: ISO 8601 in UTC, with the Z suffix

evidence_id.description: id of this evidence inside the job; unique per job (checked by code)

page.description: position of the page in the PDF file, counted from 1 (not the number printed on the page); that the page exists is checked by code

source_text.description: excerpt copied from the page; it must exist literally in the page text after normalizing spaces and hyphens (validators/citation.js). Length in code points

claim.description: the statement the excerpt supports; its numbers must appear in source_text (validators/numbers.js). Length in code points

raw.description: the number as written in source_text, in PT-BR (for example 84%); code reads it with numbers.js and checks that it appears in source_text

measures.description: raw numbers of the claim; an empty array when the claim has none. Pairing before/after for computeDeltas is code
